site.sitedescription: High altitude peat bog. Physiography: Swamp valley. Local vegetation: Xyris, Sphagnum, Eriocaulon, Drosera, Cyperus denudatus, Juncus, Helichrysum, and Alchemilla. It lies in the humid montane forest belt. Most of the area today is agricultural with sweet potatoes, beans, manihot, bananas, coffee, and tea.
